commentary: Despite the Nifty's sharp 1.85% rally back toward multi-week resistance, underlying market breadth remains defensive at 35, triggering a WEAK gate. Under Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil market-direction rules, a sharp index rebound accompanied by narrow breadth is an unconfirmed follow-through that warrants defensive posture. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate keeping risk exposure constrained to pilot allocations until institutional accumulation broadens. True leadership demands dual confirmation: Stage 2 structural alignment above rising 30-week moving averages and undeniable CANSLIM fundamental acceleration. We trade confirmed pivots with asymmetric reward-to-risk, avoid non-equity proxies, and maintain ironclad stop-loss discipline.

analysis.analyst: SEPA / CANSLIM / Stage Analysis Multi-Factor Framework

AARTIPHARM.technical: Clearing double bottom pivot at 1048.30, trading neatly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA in alignment with Minervini's Trend Template. RSI at 71 confirms upside momentum without excessive extension, while volume tracks above average (1.15x).
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM profile with revenue up 45.9% and operating profit up 79.7% YoY. Operating margins hold firm near 21%, supported by high-margin Xanthine derivatives and expanding CDMO operations. Balance sheet maintains conservative leverage and solid return metrics.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Failure back below the 963.13 swing low invalidates the base structure; execute strict Minervini risk-containment stop.

ABDL.technical: Constructing a double bottom base above all key moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200). Lower wick shows price rejection at swing support, but lack of dominant expansion volume at neckline pivot (855.55) signals hesitation.
ABDL.fundamental: Volume momentum hit a record 10m cases with premiumisation driving Prestige & Above mix to 58%, yet revenue (+6.8%) and EPS (+14.8%) fall well short of CANSLIM's 25%/15% benchmark. Margins reflect ongoing raw material pressures.
ABDL.risk: Breakdown below 798.53 violates the double bottom shelf and 50-day average; immediate loss cutting required.

ABGSEC.technical: Aditya Birla CRISIL Broad Based Gilt ETF trades tightly near its 20-session pivot (118.12) above short and long-term moving averages. However, as a fixed-income instrument, it lacks traditional equity stage dynamics and relative strength characteristics.
ABGSEC.fundamental: A passive sovereign debt ETF tracking broad-based government bonds. Corporate fundamentals such as EPS, sales growth, ROCE, and operating margins do not apply. Subject entirely to macro interest-rate cycles and duration risk.
ABGSEC.risk: Break below 116.48 signals yield curve steepening; exit immediately as fixed-income vehicles fall outside equity breakout strategies.

AIROLAM.technical: Carving a protracted Stage 1 double bottom base with 3-up recovery off the 21-EMA/50-SMA confluence. RSI at 55 reflects constructive equilibrium, but volume remains muted near the 123.89 pivot.
AIROLAM.fundamental: Decorative laminate producer exposed to cyclical interior infrastructure demand. Historical earnings reflect volatile profitability and thin operating margins. Lacks confirmed institutional sponsorship and consistent double-digit earnings acceleration.
AIROLAM.risk: Close below 103.64 breaks structural support and 200-SMA, terminating the nascent recovery base.

AJAXENGG.technical: Emerging from a constructive double bottom base above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Breakout attempt backed by 1.56x volume surge and positive MACD confirmation, demonstrating institutional accumulation toward the 635.63 pivot.
AJAXENGG.fundamental: Market leader in concrete equipment. Q2 net profit surged 30.2% YoY, demonstrating operational leverage despite modest 9.5% sales growth. Pristine balance sheet with zero net debt, ₹1,151 Cr cash reserves, and a healthy 23.9% ROCE.
AJAXENGG.risk: Violation of 594.18 stop level breaches base floor and 50-DMA, demanding immediate position liquidation.

AJMERA.technical: High-octane Darvas box breakout clearing 152.60 on extraordinary 28.87x volume expansion. Price holds firmly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, exhibiting elite relative strength and clear institutional sponsorship.
AJMERA.fundamental: Top-line expanded 62.9% YoY to ₹198.8 Cr powered by strong Mumbai redevelopment pre-sales. Net profit rose 21.3% with healthy 27.1% OPM and manageable debt-to-equity of 0.55x. EPS acceleration supports institutional accumulation.
AJMERA.risk: Drop below 135.25 negates the breakout pivot and traps breakout volume; enforce disciplined stop loss.
